app.stl_a_usar_con_un_proyecto: STL to use with a .proyecto (if it was moved)

catalog_import.vacio_se_arma_con_el_nombre: Empty: built from the file name.
catalog_import.si_el_id_ya_existe_guardar: If the id already exists, save the next version
catalog_import.stl_de_una_mano_afm_mano: STL of an afm-mano-1 hand (the one `afm extraer-mano` produces).
catalog_import.stl_cerrado_en_el_marco_del: STL closed in the accessory frame: grip axis = +X, origin at the guard face that faces the hand.
catalog_import.cualquier_stl_se_escala_se_le: Any STL: it is scaled, its handle is cut off at a plane and the grip that fits the gripping hand is added.
catalog_import.stl_cerrado_3_puntos_por_puerto: Closed STL + 3 points per port on its joining face (point 1 sets the rotation).
catalog_import.falta_al_menos_un_puerto_3: at least one port is missing (3 points on its joining face)
catalog_import.esta_en_el_mano_json_de: It is in the .mano.json of the gripping hand.
catalog_import.en_coordenadas_del_stl_original_sin: In original STL coordinates (unscaled). The side the normal (1→2 × 1→3) points to is discarded: it is the handle.
catalog_import.vacio_0_40_la_altura_de: Empty: 0.40 × the line height. Do not combine with the scale.
catalog_import.o_factor_sobre_las_unidades_del: or a factor over the STL units
catalog_import.descartar_el_otro_lado_del_plano: Discard the other side of the plane
catalog_import.vacio_el_que_deja_el_arma: Empty: the one that leaves the weapon lowest.
catalog_import.vacio_la_mas_reciente_con_agarre: Empty: the most recent one with a grip.
catalog_import.puertos_uno_por_linea_nombre_x1: Ports (one per line): NAME x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 x3 y3 z3
catalog_import.los_nombres_validos_dependen_del_tipo: Valid names depend on the type (e.g. arm: shoulder). The role comes from the part type.
catalog_import.puerto_n_name_hacen_falta_9: port %{n} (“%{name}”): 9 numbers are needed (3 X,Y,Z points), got %{n2}
catalog_import.largo_del_canal_tiene_que_ser: “Channel length” must be a number greater than 0.
catalog_import.pone_el_largo_o_el_factor: Enter the length or the scale factor, not both.
catalog_import.puerto_n_name_hay_un_valor: port %{n} (“%{name}”): a value is not a number
catalog_import.el_corte_son_tres_puntos_separados: the cut is three points separated by “;”, each with three X,Y,Z numbers (decimals with a dot)
catalog_import.taladrar_agarre_titulo: Drill a grip in a hand
catalog_import.taladrar_agarre_ayuda: Finds the channel left by the fingers and the palm of a hand already in the catalog, drills it to the requested Ø and saves it as a new version of the same piece (the old one stays; the new one does not inherit the color). With Güemes's hand, 2.4 mm is almost the maximum.
catalog_import.girar_color_ayuda: Turns the head's FBX around its neck (180° by default) and saves it as a new version of the same piece, with the same color roles. Use it when the face came out on the nape. The original FBX is needed: the saved color package already holds warped vertices.
catalog_import.girar_color_fbx_ayuda: Empty: the name the piece record gives is searched in the current folder and in the catalog.
catalog_import.girar_color_grados_ayuda: 180 flips the face; another value fixes a partial turn.
catalog_import.girar_color_grados_cero: The turn must not be 0° (a 360° turn leaves the head as it was).

catalog_manager.naranja_puertos_pasadores_de_encastre_ci: Orange: ports / snap-in pins (cylinder with its direction) · Blue: joint axis (elbow / knee), with its light-blue plane
catalog_manager.se_mueven_a_la_papelera_del: They are moved to the catalog trash (.papelera folder): “Recover deleted” puts them back.
catalog_manager.punto_1_de_3_toca_el: Point 1 of 3: tap the THUMB side of the wrist (always in the same place: it sets how the hand is rotated).
catalog_manager.punto_2_de_3_toca_un: Point 2 of 3: tap one side of the wrist, on the other side of the arm.
catalog_manager.punto_3_de_3_toca_el: Point 3 of 3: tap the third wrist point (the 3 must form a triangle, not a line).
catalog_manager.eliminar_esta_pieza_del_catalogo: Delete this part from the catalog?
catalog_manager.eliminar_estas_n_piezas_del_catalogo: Delete these %{n} parts from the catalog?
catalog_manager.las_recetas_que_las_nombran_van: Recipes that name them will fail when assembling; in the open figure those places go back to the model's part.
catalog_manager.mano_cortada_verde_muneca_v_mm: Hand cut off (green): wrist Ø%{v} mm, %{hand_volume_mm3} mm³. If green is not the hand, use “Flip side”; if it is right, check the hand id and “Save”.
catalog_manager.hace_clic_sobre_el_costado_de: Click on the side of the part, at the center of the hinge (the height and depth of the click are used).
catalog_manager.ref_es_una_pieza_tipo_solo: “%{ref}” is a “%{tipo}” part: only an arm can have its hand cut off.
catalog_manager.ref_ya_esta_sin_mano_tiene: “%{ref}” is already handless (it has the “muneca” port): choose the version with the hand attached.
catalog_manager.no_sirve_error_usa_deshacer_el: That didn't work: %{error}. Use “Undo last point” and try again.
catalog_manager.ya_estan_los_3_puntos_deshacer: All 3 points are set: use “Undo last point” to change one.
catalog_manager.ref_es_una_pieza_tipo_solo_2: “%{ref}” is a “%{tipo}” part: only an arm or a leg has a knee / elbow.
catalog_manager.ref_no_trae_articulacion_se_catalogo: “%{ref}” has no joint (it was cataloged without knee / elbow): the joint is defined on the figure and they are cataloged together.
catalog_manager.hace_clic_sobre_el_costado_de_2: Click on the side of the part, at the center of the hinge.
catalog_manager.no_hay_piezas_para_certificar_se: There are no parts to certify (arm, leg, head, pelvis and hand are certified).
catalog_manager.no_hay_una_propuesta_de_contrato: There is no problem-free contract proposal to save (calibrate it first).
catalog_manager.ese_clic_cayo_fuera_de_la: That click fell outside the image.
catalog_manager.ahi_no_hay_pieza_hace_clic: There is no part there: click on the arm.
catalog_manager.primero_elegi_los_3_puntos_de: First choose the 3 wrist points and check the cut.
catalog_manager.ahi_no_hay_pieza_hace_clic_2: There is no part there: click on the limb.
catalog_manager.moves_el_eje_el_plano_o: Move the axis, the plane or the range and the preview is recalculated.
catalog_manager.sin_cambios_respecto_de_la_version: No changes compared with the saved version.
catalog_manager.no_cambiaste_nada_no_hay_nada: You changed nothing: there is nothing to save.
catalog_manager.el_eje_se_ve_en_azul: (the axis is shown in blue in the preview)
catalog_manager.agarre_taladro_diametro_taladro_mm_mm: Grip: bore Ø%{diametro_taladro_mm} mm · channel %{get} mm · the teeth rest at ≈ %{get2}°
catalog_manager.agarre_para_taladro_taladro_mm_mm: Grip: for bore Ø%{taladro_mm} mm · shaft Ø%{get} · teeth Ø%{get2} · tab %{get3} mm · channel %{get4} mm

catalog_window.solo_recoloca_la_pieza_distal_en: It only repositions the distal part in the preview: it does not change what is saved.
catalog_window.como_afm_catalogo_listar_una_fila: Like `afm catalogo listar`: one row per part (its latest version). Unchecked, all versions are shown.
catalog_window.vuelve_a_la_vista_3_4: Returns to the 3/4 view with no zoom. Dragging with the mouse rotates the part, the wheel zooms in or out and the right button pans it; the orange dots are the ports. With “Cut off the hand…” active, a click marks a wrist point.
catalog_window.cambia_el_nombre_con_que_se: Changes the name the part is shown with (all its versions). The id and the reference do not change: the recipes and figures that use it keep assembling the same.
catalog_window.borrador_validada_impresa_es_lo_unico: draft → validated → printed. It is the only thing about a version that can be changed without creating another one.
catalog_window.volver_a_armar_aunque_el_resultado: Rebuild even if the saved result is still valid (certificar --forzar).
catalog_window.corta_en_cuanto_el_motor_informa: It stops as soon as the engine reports progress. Whatever is already certified stays saved.
catalog_window.guardar_la_propuesta_como_contrato_de: Save the proposal as the line contract?
catalog_window.reemplaza_el_contrato_actual_de_linea: It replaces the current contract in linea.json, if there is one. Saved certifications may become outdated.
catalog_window.se_quita_el_contrato_de_linea: The contract is removed from linea.json; parts no longer have a size grade. It can be calibrated again.
catalog_window.cancelando_se_corta_en_cuanto_el: Cancelling… it stops as soon as the engine reports progress.
catalog_window.si_lo_verde_no_es_la: If green is not the hand but the rest of the arm, it takes the other side of the plane as the hand.
catalog_window.pieza_mano_que_se_guarda_aparte: “Hand” part that is saved separately. If it already exists, tick “new version” or choose another id.
catalog_window.muestra_la_pieza_entera_un_clic: Shows the whole part: a click on its side puts the axis there (the height and depth of the click are used).
catalog_window.inclinacion_de_costado_0_el_eje: Side tilt 0°: the axis does not move and keeps its height; the plane is shifted.
catalog_window.vuelve_a_la_articulacion_de_la: Goes back to the joint of the saved version.
catalog_window.buscar_nombre_tipo_figura_de_origen: Search: name, type, source figure, date…
catalog_window.clic_elige_una_sola_pieza_mayus: Click selects a single part; Shift + click (or Ctrl + click) adds or removes another. Filter by text and use “Piece › Select all that are shown” to delete at once, for example, everything cataloged from a wrong project. Click a column title to sort (by “Type”, heads, torsos and legs are grouped); F2 renames the selected part.
catalog_window.devuelve_al_catalogo_el_ultimo_grupo: Returns to the catalog the last group of deleted parts (they are in the .papelera folder).
catalog_window.no_hay_nada_eliminado_para_recuperar: There is nothing deleted to recover.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_verificar_formato_hash_mall: afm catalogo verificar: format, hash, closed meshes, ports, faces and height of each part.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_contrato_ver_talles_de: afm catalogo contrato --ver: face and position size grades per port class, and each part's size grade.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_certificar_estado_no_arma: afm catalogo certificar --estado: it assembles nothing.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_certificar_arma_de_verdad: afm catalogo certificar: really assembles each part on its torso panel. It reuses what was already assembled if nothing changed; it takes minutes per host.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_certificar_forzar_vuelve_a: afm catalogo certificar --forzar: it assembles again even if compat.json already has the result.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_compat_build_validate_de: afm catalogo compat: build + validate of the recipes in figuras/ and recetas/ (cached).
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_matriz_matriz_barata_del: afm catalogo matriz: cheap catalog matrix and the saved full results.
catalog_window.escribir_compatibilidad_md_validando_ant: Write COMPATIBILIDAD.md validating the recipes first
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_capacidad_hasta_donde_llega: afm catalogo capacidad: how far the gap of each pin socket reaches. It saves nothing.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_capacidad_escribir_ademas_e: afm catalogo capacidad --escribir: it also writes the measurement into the .pieza.json files (asks for confirmation).
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_contrato_calibrar_toleranci: afm catalogo contrato --calibrar (0.4 mm tolerance, equivalent radius; another tolerance or metric, in the console). It saves nothing.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_contrato_calibrar_guardar_e: afm catalogo contrato --calibrar --guardar: writes the latest proposal to linea.json (asks for confirmation). Only if it has no problems.
catalog_window.no_se_pudo_empezar_la_importacion: The import could not be started.
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_certificar_id_arma_la: afm catalogo certificar ID: assembles the chosen part on a catalog torso panel (its own figure and those with the lowest, median and highest capacity).
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_cobertura_id_cuantas_piezas: afm catalogo cobertura ID: how many catalog parts accept each port of this part (from metadata, instant).
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_capacidad_id_hasta_donde: afm catalogo capacidad ID: how far the gap of the part's pin sockets reaches (it saves nothing; to save, Catalog → Measure and save the capacity…).
catalog_window.afm_catalogo_explicar_id_por_que: afm catalogo explicar ID: why it couples (or not) with each other part: radii, IoU, step and reasons.
catalog_window.guardar_la_capacidad_medida_de_n: Save the measured capacity of %{n} part(s)?
catalog_window.se_escribe_en_el_pieza_json: It is written into the .pieza.json of each part (the capacity field of its sockets). It is what `afm catalogo capacidad --escribir` does.
catalog_window.la_propuesta_tiene_problemas_no_se: The proposal has problems: it cannot be saved.
catalog_window.propuesta_lista_si_te_sirve_catalogo: Proposal ready. If it works for you: Catalog → Save the contract proposal…
catalog_window.contrato_guardado_en_linea_json_huella: Contract saved in linea.json (fingerprint %{digest}). The certification is checked against the new contract.
catalog_window.version_nueva_si_ya_existe: new version if it already exists
catalog_window.no_hay_vista_previa_de_la: There is no preview of the part to mark the wrist on.
catalog_window.le_corta_la_mano_al_brazo: It cuts the hand off the arm: you tap 3 wrist points on the preview and a new version of the handless arm is saved, plus the hand as a separate part (the original arm is untouched).
catalog_window.sube_o_baja_el_eje_de: Raises or lowers the hinge axis vertically. Higher = the gap takes more material from the limb.
catalog_window.angulo_del_eje_visto_de_frente: Angle of the axis seen from the front (0 = along X; + = z rises with x).
catalog_window.angulo_del_plano_visto_de_costado: Angle of the plane seen from the side (+ = rises toward +Y). 0 = straight plane: the axis does not move; what shifts is the plane.
catalog_window.flexion_minima_del_rango_de_la: Minimum bend of the joint's range.
catalog_window.flexion_maxima_del_rango_de_la: Maximum bend of the joint's range.
catalog_window.mover_el_eje_con_un_clic: Move the axis with a click
catalog_window.no_hay_vista_previa_de_la_2: There is no preview of the part.
catalog_window.move_el_eje_de_la_bisagra: Move the hinge axis, tilt the plane or change the range while watching how much material the gap removes; it is saved as a new version of the part (the current one is untouched).
catalog_window.ref_no_esta_en_la_lista: “%{ref}” is not in the list (is a filter on?).
catalog_window.ordenar_por_title_otro_clic_invierte: Sort by “%{title}” (another click reverses the order)
catalog_window.arrastra_para_girar_rueda_o_pellizco: Drag to rotate · wheel or pinch = zoom · right button = pan · orange = ports
catalog_window.se_guarda_como_version_nueva_borrador: It is saved as a new version (draft); the current one is untouched.
catalog_window.elegi_una_pieza_de_la_lista: Pick a part from the list to view it.
catalog_window.no_se_pudo_leer_la_malla: The mesh of %{ref} could not be read: %{exc}
catalog_window.nombre_para_id_se_aplica_a: Name for “%{id}” (applies to all its versions). Empty = show the id again.
catalog_window.no_se_pudo_guardar_el_informe: The report could not be saved: %{exc}
catalog_window.color_listo: Color preview (approximate: the final color is baked when the figure is built).
catalog_window.color_error: Could not show the color of %{ref}: %{exc}
catalog_window.retocar_tip: Fix the piece's color by hand with brush strokes using the line palette roles. It applies to every figure that uses this piece.
catalog_window.retocar_elegi_una_pieza: Pick a piece with color from the list.
catalog_window.retocar_solo_roles: Only pieces with role-based color can be retouched.
catalog_window.retocar_sin_paleta: The line has no palette: define one before retouching.
catalog_window.retocar_radio_tip: Brush radius in real piece mm.
catalog_window.retocar_herramientas_tip: Shows the retouch tool window (paint, erase, colors…).
catalog_window.retocar_pintar_tip: Paints with the chosen color by dragging over the piece (including what the FBX does not cover).
catalog_window.retocar_borrar_tip: Puts painted areas back to the role the piece came with.
catalog_window.retocar_ver_resultado_tip: Shows the piece with the real retouch color, without saving.
catalog_window.retocar_descartar_tip: Goes back to what is saved in the catalog.
catalog_window.retocar_ayuda: Drag to paint; in “Fill”, one click paints the whole connected region of the same color; Shift + drag rotates; right button pans; wheel zooms. Ctrl+Z undoes.
catalog_window.retocar_rellenar_tip: One click paints, with the chosen role, the whole connected region of the same color as the point (up to the given reach).
catalog_window.retocar_poligono_tip: Paint, Erase and No source act on the whole triangle of the piece under the mouse (the one lit in cyan), whatever the radius. Dragging paints every polygon you cross.
catalog_window.retocar_sin_origen_tip: Paints with the chosen role only what the FBX color does not cover (surfaces with no source), within the radius. Anything that already has FBX color is left alone.
catalog_window.retocar_alcance_tip: How far “Fill” goes from the click, in mm.
catalog_window.retocar_exportar_tip: Saves the current strokes to a file to use on another piece.
catalog_window.retocar_importar_tip: Adds the strokes of a file (a single undo step).
catalog_window.retocar_traer_tip: Adds the retouch of another catalog piece or version (a single undo step).
catalog_window.retocar_espejar_tip: When importing or bringing, mirrors the strokes in X: left side to right side.
catalog_window.retocar_sin_otras: No other piece has a retouch.
catalog_window.retocar_sin_nada: There are no strokes to export.
catalog_window.taladrar_agarre_ayuda: Drills the weapon grip in the selected hand and saves it as a new version (afm catalogo taladrar-mano)
catalog_window.elegi_una_sola_mano: Choose a single hand from the list.
catalog_window.girar_color_tip: Turns the selected head's color 180° around the neck (the face came out on the nape) and saves it as a new version (afm catalogo color-girar)
catalog_window.girar_color_elegi_una_pieza: Pick a single head with role color
catalog_window.girar_color_solo_cabeza: «Turn color» is for heads (or pieces with a neck) that have role color
catalog_window.menu_pieza_tip: Name, state and deletion of the selected piece (or several)
catalog_window.menu_editar_tip: Change the geometry of the selected piece: cut the hand, drill the grip, readjust the joint
catalog_window.menu_color_tip: Retouch or turn the piece's color, and the line's role palette
catalog_window.menu_analisis_tip: Certify the selected piece and see its coverage, capacity and mounts
catalog_window.menu_importar_tip: Add a hand, an accessory, a weapon or a loose piece to the catalog from an STL
catalog_window.menu_catalogo_tip: Commands for the whole catalog: verify, contract, certify all, compatibility, capacity
catalog_window.menu_vista_tip: Back to the 3/4 view and zoom the piece in or out

controller.rebaba_a_rebajar_en_la_cara: Burr to shave off the face (mm)
controller.corte_con_la_cama_de_impresion: Cut against the print bed: height above the bed (mm)
controller.torso_espejado_1_si_0_conserva: Mirrored torso (1 = yes, 0 = keeps the STL's asymmetric design)

controller.cintura_giro_libre_a_cada_lado: Waist: free rotation to each side to validate (°)
controller.mano_articulada_vastago_mm_se_achica: Articulated hand: shaft Ø (mm; it shrinks only if it does not fit in the wrist)
controller.mano_articulada_largo_vastago_mm_labio: Articulated hand: shaft length (mm; lip behind the head = length − 2·clearance)
controller.hombro_mecanismo_de_clic_1_si: Shoulder: click mechanism (1 = yes, 0 = mushroom only)
controller.cadera_mecanismo_de_clic_1_si: Hip: click mechanism (1 = yes, 0 = mushroom only)
controller.clic_angulo_del_brazo_al_imprimir: Click: arm angle when printing (°; click phase)
controller.rodilla_codo_lengueta_con_cuello_recto: Knee/elbow: tab with straight neck (1 = yes, 0 = disc)
controller.rodilla_codo_bastago_pasante_1_si: Knee/elbow: through shaft (1 = yes, 0 = two pins)

controller.abri_un_stl_para_empezar: Open an STL to get started.
controller.no_hay_ninguna_articulacion_para_previsu: There is no joint to preview: add the knee or elbow of a limb, or a leg (hip).
controller.aviso_cruza_con_el_del_otro: Warning: it crosses the one on the other side by %{v} mm (shorten shaft_len / head_h or use a plane further out).
controller.el_brazo_con_clic_cuelga_cuelga: The arm with a click hangs %{cuelga_mm} mm below the plane: to make it rest, the click must be at %{angulo_apoyo}° (now %{angulo_actual}°): use “Adjust the arm's click” and generate again.
controller.corte_con_la_cama_de_impresion_2: Cut against the print bed: %{depth} mm above the bed (z = %{v} mm).
controller.voladizos_en_rojo_pared_a_mas: Overhangs in red (wall more than %{overhang_angle}° from vertical): %{overhang_area} mm² with the figure seen from the front, head up. Reference for the whole figure; generate it and view it in the hip pose to see those of the parts.
controller.mano_estandar_pegada_turquesa_muneca_del: Standard hand attached (turquoise): model wrist Ø%{v} mm, hand Ø%{v2} mm. If it does not land well, use “Flip side” or the rotation.
controller.revisadas_n_pieza_s_sin_generar: Checked %{n} part(s) without generating: %{v} fine, %{n2} with warnings, %{n3} with problems.
controller.brazo_sin_mano_ref_mano_ref2: Handless arm: %{ref}; hand: %{ref2} (wrist Ø%{v} mm). %{from_ref} was not touched.
controller.articulacion_name_reajustada_version_nue: Joint “%{name}” readjusted: new version %{ref} (draft). %{ref2} was not touched.
controller.cabeza_de_reemplazo_lista_se_ve: Replacement head ready (shown in orange, resting on the neck): scale ×%{escala} (uniform), height %{alto_mm} mm, base matches %{v} %%.
controller.relleno_de_muslos_no_se_aplico: Thigh fill: not applied (the reason is in WARNING).
controller.la_figura_se_genero_pero_tiene: The figure was generated but has problems:
controller.n_aviso_s_de_soldado_el: %{n} welding warning(s) (the slicer may warn about non-manifold edges)
controller.en_una_figura_armada_solo_con: Undo is not yet available on a figure assembled only from catalog parts.
controller.figura_armada_con_piezas_de_catalogo: (figure assembled from catalog parts, no STL)
controller.hay_una_tarea_en_curso_revisando: A task is in progress (checking or generating): wait for it to finish before changing %{what}.
controller.hace_clic_en_la_coronilla_el: Click on the crown (the highest point, excluding hat or ears).
controller.plano_de_simetria_elegi_3_puntos: Symmetry plane: pick 3 points on the center line (2 on the back and 1 on the chest).
controller.plano_del_kind_base_elegi_3: %{kind_base} plane: pick 3 points on the figure.

figure_window.vista_corte_titulo: “No supports” cut view (the blue plane is the bed; red is what gets cut):
figure_window.receta_abierta_path_retocala_y_guardala:
Recipe opened: %{path}
Tweak it and save it under another name, or assemble it.
figure_window.carga_una_receta_guardada_piezas_opcione: Loads a saved recipe (parts, options, hand and scales) so you can tweak it. Save it under another name so you do not overwrite the original.
figure_window.guarda_las_piezas_elegidas_en_catalogo: Saves the chosen parts to <catalog>/figuras/<name>.receta.json (it can be assembled again with “afm armar” and counts as a use of each part).
figure_window.abre_el_proyecto_recien_exportado_sin: Opens the just-exported .proyecto (no STL: the body comes from the catalog) and the figure is shown in parts. It replaces whatever is open in the main window.
figure_window.gira_la_mano_alrededor_de_la: Rotates the hand around the wrist. 0 = as the catalog stores it.
figure_window.sin_marcar_la_base_de_la: Unchecked, the hand's base sinks into the arm and is welded (overlap). Checked, the hand comes out as a separate part with a pin that goes into the arm and turns freely.
figure_window.cuanto_se_hunde_la_base_de: How much the hand's base sinks into the arm (only with the welded hand, without “Articulated hand”).
figure_window.pone_las_piezas_elegidas_en_su: Puts the chosen parts in place (with their scales and the hand) and draws them together, without generating: useful to see proportions and joints before waiting for the assembly. It does not include pins or clearances.
figure_window.armando_la_figura_tarda_unos_minutos: Assembling the figure… (it takes a few minutes)
figure_window.codo_rodilla_ayuda: Without elbow / knee the arm or leg is built rigid, in one piece (simpler toy: 6 articulation points). Only selectable when the catalog piece has the joint.
figure_window.abrir_la_figura_armada_en_la: Open the assembled figure in the main window
figure_window.el_torso_arma_el_cuerpo_uno: The torso builds the body: a whole one, or “torso_sup” + a pelvis (the figure has a waist). Each part in the list says how it couples to the one already chosen (ok / warning / does not couple). Assembling takes a few minutes; it exports the parts, the assembled figure, the report, the recipe and a .proyecto (openable in the main window without the STL) to the folder you choose.
figure_window.accesorios_que_acompanan_a_la_figura: Accessories that go with the figure
figure_window.escala_de_cada_pieza_x_ancho: Scale of each part (X width · Y depth · Z height)
figure_window.los_tres_ejes_se_mueven_juntos: The three axes move together (uniform scale).
figure_window.la_pieza_se_escala_alrededor_de: The part is scaled around its main joint and the others are coupled again. Pins and clearances are not scaled (they are print mm). The hand is always in real mm. Check the validation when assembling.

catalogo.explorar_catalogos_en_linea_tip: Search for packages of parts, lines and figures published in community indexes and install them into your catalog (always with your confirmation).
catalogo.nuevo_heroe_desde_el_patron_p: New hero from the template (e.g. Güemes)…
catalogo.crea_el_proyecto_de_un_heroe: Creates a new hero's project by copying the planes from the template figure's project (waist, neck, knees, elbows, wrist, pins and parameters) and redrawing the outlines on the hero's mesh. It opens it and shows an image so you can check the planes land well. It does not copy trims, catalog parts or the template's scales.
catalogo.guia_de_cortes_cuanto_del_catalogo: Cut guide (how much of the catalog accepts them)…
catalogo.mide_la_cara_de_cada_corte: Measures the face of each cut (shoulder, hip, neck) without generating anything and counts how many parts of the open catalog accept it, as a part of this figure and as a torso that receives parts from others.
catalogo.ajustar_cintura_y_muneca_al_patron: Adjust waist and wrist to the template…
catalogo.mueve_el_plano_de_la_cintura: Moves this figure's waist and wrist planes until their faces have the size of the template's pelvis and hand (e.g. Güemes) from the open catalog. It shows what would change before applying it.
catalogo.cierra_el_catalogo_y_borra_lo: Closes the catalog and erases what was remembered: next time you have to open it manually. It does not touch the folder or the project.
catalogo.alinear_todos_los_cortes_a_la: Align all cuts to the line
catalogo.dividir_figura_actual_y_ajustar_piezas: Split current figure and adjust parts…
catalogo.tu_figura_en_piezas_al_lado: Your figure in parts beside the body of a catalog template figure (e.g. Güemes), in three views, so you can match each part's scale while watching the result.
catalogo.abrir_crear_administrar_o_catalogar_guia: Open, create, manage or catalog; cut guide and template adjustment
catalogo.elegi_en_cada_lugar_la_pieza: Choose for each place the model's part or one from the catalog. “Check” measures the coupling without generating; ✓ ok · ⚠ warning · ✗ no. All the detail is in “Catalog help”.
catalogo.crear_catalogo_arma_una_carpeta_nueva: “Create catalog” builds a new folder for the line (name and figure height; it is the same as “afm catalogo crear”) and leaves it open. If you already have one, open it with “Open catalog”. “Catalog this figure” (you choose the places and whether it goes as a new version; with a replacement head it saves THAT head) saves its raw parts (head, torso, arm, leg, with the planes and outlines you already defined) to use in other figures. In each place choose “the model's” or a catalog part: “Generate figure” puts it on the port the model has in that place, without scaling it, and the row shows how it couples (ok / warning / no, IoU and step between the faces). The catalog hand couples to the catalog arm's wrist. “Check” measures each part's coupling WITHOUT generating and draws it already placed (green = ok, amber = warning, red = no); “See why” overlays the two faces. A lone pelvis keeps the model's torso, arms and legs: define the waist plane first. “Assemble figure from catalog” (also in the top bar) builds a NEW figure without opening an STL: one part per place, each marked with how it couples to the one already chosen, and exports the parts, the assembled figure and the recipe. “Manage catalog” opens a window with all the part versions, a 3/4 preview of each and deletion of one or several (useful if you cataloged from a wrong project); this figure's places that used a deleted part go back to the model's. “Split current figure” separates the raw parts to adjust their scale (a single one or per X, Y, Z axis; it works for the model's part and the catalog's); ports follow the change and pins are regenerated with the project's measurements. Arms and legs are adjusted as a mirrored pair. “Reset” goes back to the original proportions. With a catalog torso the figure comes entirely from the catalog. The catalog reopens by itself when you load the figure.
catalogo.dibujar_las_piezas_elegidas_antes_de: Draw the chosen parts before generating
catalogo.pieza_de_cada_lugar_al_cambiar: Part for each place (changing it requires generating)

figura.muestra_en_el_lado_oculto_x: Shows, on the hidden side (x < 0), the reflection of what you do on the +X side: the figure, the outlines (also the one you are drawing), the pins and the trims. It is what comes out when generating: one side and its mirror.
figura.hace_falta_haber_generado_la_figura: The figure must have been generated. The legs rotate on the hip pin (0° = standing, 90° = seated) and parts that collide with the torso or with each other are painted red; the result, with the hip limit carved in, goes in the Status.
figura.trabajar_un_solo_lado_oculta_x: Work on one side only (hides x < 0)
figura.espejo_en_vivo_trabaja_un_solo: Live mirror (work on one side only)
figura.ver_la_figura_generada_en_la: View the generated figure in the hip pose

generar.generar_puede_tardar_varios_minutos_si: Generating can take several minutes. If you change anything afterwards, you must generate again before exporting.
generar.corta_con_un_plano_horizontal_sobre: Cuts with a horizontal plane above the bed (height in the row below) and rotates the arms forward just enough to rest on that plane. The legs stay straight (knee at 0°): thigh and calf horizontal on the plane. The arms are not modified.
generar.el_corte_plano_le_saca_a: The flat cut removes a slice from the pelvis and, standing, a gap is left against the thigh. With this, the thigh keeps that slice and the pelvis is carved again around it (the thigh turns freely up to the hip limit). It shows on export; it takes a bit longer.
generar.ajustar_la_altura_del_corte_vista: Adjust the cut height (Right view, seated figure)
generar.muestra_la_figura_generada_sentada_de: Shows the generated figure seated, from the side, with the horizontal plane of the “no supports” cut. Click at the height you want, or ↑ ↓ (Shift = 1 mm). Esc finishes.
generar.ajustar_el_clic_del_brazo_para: Adjust the arm's click so it rests without supports (you must generate again)
generar.el_brazo_con_clic_no_se: The arm with a click cannot be rotated after generating: its pose is set by the click phase. It sets “Click: arm angle when printing” to the angle at which the arm rests on the cutting plane.
generar.estas_opciones_se_aplican_al_exportar: These options are applied when exporting with the “Export” button in the top bar (it comes from the already generated figure).
generar.apoyar_las_piezas_en_la_cama: Rest the parts on the bed when exporting (in the hip pose, head up)
generar.modificar_para_imprimir_sin_soportes_apl: Modify for printing without supports (flattens legs and tail; arms rotate forward)
generar.rellenar_los_muslos_hasta_la_pelvis: Fill the thighs up to the trimmed pelvis
generar.bambu_activar: Also export a flat-colour 3MF / OBJ for Bambu Studio
generar.bambu_activar_tip: Besides the parts, writes <name>_bambu.3mf and <name>_bambu.obj with ONE flat colour per triangle (no texture): Bambu Studio reads them without the errors of the textured GLB. The figure needs colour.
generar.bambu_colores_tip: If the figure uses more colours they are reduced to this number for the whole figure at once. Every extra colour adds filament changes and purge tower.
generar.bambu_min: Merge colours covering less than (% of area)
generar.bambu_min_tip: A colour that covers less than this is merged with the most similar one.
generar.bambu_nota: The figure needs colour (see «Colour» in Parameters). In Bambu Studio open the .obj or the .3mf and assign each colour to a filament. It does not change the recipe or the geometry.
generar.bambu_sel_ayuda: Tick the colours you want to use: the ones you remove are merged with the most similar of those that remain. The button changes the colour each one is written with (the filament you will assign) without touching the palette. The colours show up after «Export» with colour.
generar.bambu_sel_sin_figura: Export the figure with colour to see its colours and choose which ones go into the 3MF.
generar.bambu_vista_tip: Shows the exported figure with the flat colours that will go into the 3MF (one colour per triangle, no texture). It updates when you touch the selector.
generar.bambu_sel_auto_tip: Picks the colours again from the cap and % above, and removes the output colour changes.
generar.bambu_exportar_ahora_tip: Rewrites only <name>_bambu.3mf / .obj / .mtl with these colours in the folder of the last «Export», without exporting everything else again.

miembros.subir_el_borde_superior_2_a: Raise the top edge (2nd outline) up to the other outline
miembros.pin_mas_ancho: Move to the widest point of the face
miembros.pin_achicar: Shrink the pin so it fits
miembros.pin_simular: Simulate the swing with this pin (shoulder / hip)
miembros.elegi_colocar_el_pasador_marcador_en: Choose “Place the pin” (marker) on a limb in the plane list. The cut face is shown head-on, with the torso trimmed: the orange circle is the shaft and the yellow one the mushroom head; the green dot is where the program would put it. Click on the face = move the pin; arrows = adjust 0.1 mm (Shift: 1 mm). With a catalog open, the circle that follows the pointer is the sight: green if almost all catalog parts accept it, yellow if only some, red if none (informative, not a guarantee); “Snap” (M) looks for the best position within ±2 mm. The green / yellow / red dots on the face are the heat map (swept once on entry; H hides it). If you do not touch it, the automatic position is used.
miembros.en_la_fila_de_cada_miembro_de: In the row of each limb in the list above, “Draw outline” (or “Edit outline”) opens the outline and “Draw 2nd outline” the 2nd one, from the front; the ✕ of each one removes only that outline, and the trash can on the right removes the whole plane (the limb is what stays inside the two outlines: e.g. on a leg, the thigh column + the hip step). Click = vertex on the plane; close with a click on the first one or with Enter. Once closed: click on a vertex and then click to move it; click on an edge adds one; Backspace deletes the picked one.

parametros.reescala_la_figura_y_los_planos: Rescales the figure (and the planes, outlines and trims already made) to this height. Pins, clearance and click are absolute measurements and are not scaled.
parametros.un_perfil_guarda_estos_parametros_para: A profile saves these parameters to reuse them in the line's next figure.
parametros.arma_solo_la_rodilla_el_codo: It assembles ONLY the knee, elbow or hip (trimmed around the axis) to see how much material the gap removes while you move the axis, the plane or the range, without waiting for “Generate figure”. It recalculates by itself (a few seconds) and shows the last result until the new one arrives. With the preview on, the figure is hidden. On a figure assembled from the catalog, the part's joint is shown as it was cataloged (the axis and plane do not move here). The hip shows the pin and the sweep gap in the pelvis: “Displayed bend” rotates the thigh (0° standing, up to the seated pose).
parametros.ver_solo_la_articulacion_sin_generar: View the joint only (without generating the figure)
parametros.angulo_del_plano_visto_de_costado: Angle of the plane seen from the side (+ = rises toward +Y). 0 = straight plane: the axis does not move and keeps its height; what shifts is the plane.
parametros.probetas_ayuda: 1) Generate the coupons. 2) Print them: each piece has its number embossed (the same as in the table) and probetas.3mf holds one named object per cell for the slicer’s object list. 3) Try them: the piece with the handle must turn without sticking and without wobbling. 4) Pick the best number below and “Use this cell”; then save the profile.
parametros.probetas_resultado: Test result: which number was best?

plane_panel.interruptor_general_se_combina_con_el: Master switch: combined with each plane's own in the list
plane_panel.marcas_de_los_pasadores_hombro_cadera: Pin marks (shoulder, hip, neck) and hinge axes (knee, elbow)
plane_panel.siluetas_de_los_miembros_1_o: Limb outlines (1st and 2nd outline) and manual trims
plane_panel.numerar_los_cortes_en_el_visor: Number the cuts in the viewer
plane_panel.todavia_no_hay_planos_agregalos_en: There are no planes yet. Add them in the “Planes” tab (symmetry, arm, leg).
plane_panel.durante_la_seleccion_retroceso_deshace_e: During selection: Backspace undoes the last point, Esc cancels.
plane_panel.cortes_distintos_tooltip: For asymmetric figures: the right side gets its own outlines, planes and pins instead of mirroring the left one.

planos.arma_el_brazo_y_la_pierna: It assembles this figure's arm and leg on each catalog torso, seats the leg and measures whether they collide. It takes a while (it loads the meshes): it is measured only at the chosen position. If it collides, a violet dot appears on the band.
planos.figura_del_catalogo_cuyo_corte_de:
Catalog figure whose arm and leg cut is taken as a reference: below it says how many mm from the symmetry plane 
it cuts, and in the viewer a light-blue guide marks that distance.
planos.mueve_el_corte_del_brazo_o: Moves the active arm or leg cut to the distance at which the reference figure cuts. It is the same movement as “Cut at”: afterwards the pin must be checked.
planos.con_un_catalogo_abierto_pinta_la: With a catalog open: it paints the cut section with the color of how much of the catalog accepts it (green = almost all, yellow = some, red = none) and leaves a band of dots of the same color along the distance to the symmetry plane, ±3 mm every 0.25 mm; the white dot is the best position on the band. It is informative (it does not check the collision in the seated pose).
planos.ir_a_la_mejor_posicion_del: Go to the best cut position (M)
planos.el_iman_del_corte_mueve_el: The cut snap: moves the plane to the best position on the band (±3 mm). It only changes the distance to the symmetry plane; afterwards the pin must be checked.
planos.medir_choque_en_pose_sentada: Measure collision in the seated pose
planos.agregar_rodilla_a_una_pierna_3: Add a knee to a leg (3 points)
planos.agregar_codo_a_un_brazo_3: Add an elbow to an arm (3 points)
planos.agregar_codo_siguiendo_el_brazo_2: Add an elbow following the arm (2 lines, from the front)
planos.agregar_cintura_cortar_el_torso_y: Add waist: cut the torso and turn sideways (3 points)
planos.elegir_donde_va_el_pasador_de: Choose where the waist pin goes (side view)
planos.con_un_pasador_elegido_el_puerto: With a pin chosen, the “cintura” port that is cataloged goes on it (like the neck and the limbs); if not chosen, it stays at the center of the face, as always. Click = move; arrows = 0.1 mm; M = snap; H = heat map.
planos.pasador_de_la_cintura_volver_a: Waist pin: back to the automatic position
planos.extraer_mano_estandar_de_esta_figura: Extract the standard hand from this figure (3 points on the left wrist)
planos.mano_de_reemplazo_stl_3_puntos: Replacement hand (STL)… (3 points on the wrist)
planos.elegi_el_stl_de_la_mano: Choose the standard hand's STL and mark 3 points on this model's wrist (either arm). Point 1 goes in the same place as when extracting the hand (e.g. the thumb side): this way it ends up oriented without touching the rotation. The model's original hand is discarded and the standard one is attached unscaled (shown in turquoise); the other arm comes out by mirroring. The arm's outline must include the new hand: “Generate figure” warns if not. “Articulated hand”: instead of welding it, the hand comes out as a separate part with a pin that goes into the arm and turns freely (it shrinks only if the wrist is thin; see Parameters → Articulated hand).
planos.para_armas_y_otros_accesorios_que: For weapons and other accessories held in the fist without glue. Choose the standard hand's STL: the program finds the channel the fingers leave with the palm and bores it to the requested Ø (with Güemes' hand, 2.4 mm is almost the maximum; more opens the ring). Save the hand with a grip and attach it with “Replacement hand (STL)…”. The test plate has one sword for each teeth Ø, lying flat (the tabs flex in the plane of the bed): print it, preferably in PETG, and see which one holds without breaking the tab. The bore is done once on the standard hand: the whole line of figures shares it.
planos.elegir_plano_de_corte_del_mango: Choose the handle's cutting plane (3 clicks)
planos.invertir_el_lado_que_se_descarta: Flip the side that is discarded
planos.guardar_el_arma_en_el_catalogo: Save the weapon to the catalog
planos.importa_cualquier_stl_como_arma_de: Imports any STL as a weapon of the line: it is scaled (by default, 0.40 × the line height), you choose with 3 clicks the plane that cuts the original handle and the program adds the toothed grip that fits the gripping hand of the open catalog. The result is shown on top of the weapon (translucent). With “Save” it stays in the catalog as an “accessory” part and can be chosen for any figure of the line. If the handle ends up thicker than the shaft, print it with support under the shaft.
planos.accesorios_que_viajan_con_la_figura: Accessories that travel with the figure
planos.armas_y_accesorios_del_catalogo_que: Catalog weapons and accessories that go with this figure: on export they come out as separate STLs in piezas/ (ready to print) and inside the assembly, beside the figure. They are saved in the .proyecto. They are not attached to the fist. Each one says whether it is held in this figure's attached hand.
planos.cortar_la_base_de_la_cabeza: Cut the replacement head's base (3 points)
planos.elegir_donde_va_el_pasador_del: Choose where the neck pin goes (side view)
planos.pasador_del_cuello_volver_a_la: Neck pin: back to the automatic position
planos.pasador_del_cuello_elegir_donde_va: Neck pin: “Choose where it goes…” sets the side view (the neck is seen edge-on). A click moves it forward or backward on the neck face (always centered at x = 0); with arrows it is adjusted 0.1 mm at a time (Shift, 1 mm). The pin's outline (shaft and head) is shown in orange; the automatic position in green.
planos.la_cabeza_de_reemplazo_se_ve: The replacement head is shown in orange over the neck (the original is hidden). Orientation: “up” axis and X / Y / Z rotations (rotations are applied in that order). Scale: 1.00 leaves the base equal to the neck's; more or less enlarges or shrinks the whole head. Base cut: pick 3 points on the orange head; the plane they form becomes the base (what is below is discarded) and follows the mesh if you rotate it later. If the base hardly matches the neck's, try another rotation, scale or cut: the fit is recalculated instantly.
planos.mostrar_ocultar_el_plano_celeste_de: Show / hide the reference's light-blue plane in the viewer
planos.dibuja_translucidas_las_piezas_de_la: Draws the reference figure's parts (torso or pelvis and the limb) translucent over yours, with the cut in place. It is not scaled: it uses the reference's mm.
planos.ver_una_espada_de_prueba_en: See a test sword in the figure's attached hand
planos.giro_automatico_sobre_la_empunadura_arma: Automatic rotation about the grip (weapon lying flat)
planos.si_el_id_ya_existe_guardar: If the id already exists, save a new version
planos.corte_a_mm_del_plano_de: Cut at (mm from the symmetry plane)
planos.pegar_la_mano_estandar_en_este: Attach the standard hand to this model
planos.agregar_cintura_paralela_al_piso_una: Add waist parallel to the floor (one height)
planos.corta_el_torso_con_un_plano: Cuts the torso with a horizontal plane (parallel to the figure’s floor) instead of picking 3 points. It moves in parallel with “Height above the floor”, with a click on the figure or with ↑ ↓.
planos.agregar_corte_de_la_cabeza_paralelo_al: Add head cut parallel to the floor (one height)
planos.corta_la_cabeza_con_un_plano: Cuts the head with a horizontal plane (parallel to the figure’s floor) instead of picking 3 points. It moves in parallel with “Height above the floor”, with a click on the figure or with ↑ ↓.
planos.traslada_el_plano_de_corte_en_paralelo: Moves the cut plane parallel to the floor. Also: click on the figure or ↑ ↓ arrows (Shift = 1 mm) with the tool active.
planos.ver_la_mano_estandar_sobre_el_mango: Show the hand with grip on the handle
planos.el_canal_es_una_de_las: Channel: the hand has up to 4 possible hole directions; 1 is the one with the thickest walls (the usual one). The fine tilt goes up to ±15° and is rejected if the ring is left thinner than the minimum wall.
planos.previsualizar_el_agarre_sin_taladrar: Preview the grip without boring (on the attached hand)
planos.agarre_elegir_plano: 1) Pick the plane (3 points on the hand)
planos.agarre_elegir_final: 3) Optional: move the center to the far end of the hand
planos.agarre_ayuda_manual: Chosen by hand: 1) three points on the hand set the grip plane (the entry face, like a weapon's plane); 2) one click marks the circle center on that plane, where the cylinder subtracted from the hand starts; 3) optional: the center can be moved to the far end of the hand (the axis tilts). “Preview the grip” must be on to see the hand and pick.
planos.guardar_la_mano_en_el_catalogo: Save the drilled hand to the catalog

rail.salta_al_primer_paso_que_todavia: Jumps to the first step that still asks for something (○ missing · ⚠ review · ⟳ out of date · ▶ ready to generate).

recortes.para_los_ajustes_propios_de_cada: For each figure's own adjustments (e.g. the “belly sphere”): you draw a polygon on the symmetry plane (seen from the side) or place a sphere / box / cylinder with a click on the figure; it is extruded and subtracted from or united to a part. It is done on the +X side and mirrored. It must reach the surface: a closed void inside is discarded.
recortes.dibujar_poligono_colocar_con_clic: Draw polygon / place with a click

ui_consts.cabeza_de_reemplazo_giro_z_sobre: Replacement head: Z rotation, about the neck (°)

weapon_session.elegi_el_plano_de_corte_3: choose the cutting plane (3 points on the weapon)
weapon_session.elegi_el_catalogo_de_la_linea: choose the line's catalog (it needs a gripping hand)
weapon_session.no_se_pudo_armar_el_arma: the weapon could not be assembled: %{exc}
weapon_session.empunadura_para_la_mano_ref_diametro: Grip for hand %{ref} (Ø%{diametro_taladro_mm} mm, channel %{largo_canal_mm} mm)

window.para_subir_solo_una_cabeza_nueva: To upload just a new head, tick only “Head” and “new version”: the rest of the catalog is not touched and the figures that already use the previous version keep using it.
window.se_va_a_descartar_la_figura: The loaded figure and everything done with it (planes, outlines, joints, parameters) will be discarded and it goes back to the starting values.
window.figura_nueva_solo_con_piezas_del: A new figure from catalog parts only, without opening an STL or a project.
window.abrir_un_stl_un_proyecto_o: Open an STL, a project or assemble a figure from the catalog
window.descarta_la_figura_cargada_y_vuelve: Discards the loaded figure and goes back to the starting values.
window.guarda_el_proyecto_sobrescribe_el_proyec: Saves the project: overwrites the open .proyecto or asks where the first time.
window.genera_y_guarda_las_piezas_para: Generates and saves the parts to print.
window.cubo_de_vista_clic_en_una: View cube: click a face, edge or vertex to look from there; drag to orbit
window.corta_la_tarea_cuando_termine_el: Stops the task when the current step finishes (a long step cannot be interrupted halfway).
window.con_un_catalogo_abierto_pinta_la: With a catalog open: it paints the plane's section with the color of how much of the catalog accepts it (green = almost all, yellow = some, red = none) and a band of dots along the plane's normal, ±4 mm every 0.5 mm; the white dot is the best position. Informative, not a guarantee.
window.desliza_el_plano_a_la_mejor: Slides the plane to the best position on the band (±4 mm along its normal). It discards the chosen pin: it must be checked again. (The M key still moves only a limb's side cut.)
window.midiendo_el_choque_en_pose_sentada: Measuring the collision in the seated pose…
window.dividiendo_la_figura_en_piezas_crudas: Splitting the figure into raw parts…
window.escribe_la_escala_de_la_pieza: Writes the “pelvis” part's scale (the inverse of the hero's remaining scale) when it falls within the ±10 %% cap. The hand is not rescaled.
window.la_cabeza_que_se_guarda_es: The head that is saved is the replacement one you imported (already scaled to the neck base), not the model's.
window.generar_con_esto_probablemente_falle_o: Generating with this will probably fail or leave the joint wrong.
window.hay_cambios_sin_guardar_se_van: There are unsaved changes: they will be lost.
window.lo_que_no_este_guardado_se: Whatever is not saved will be lost.
window.carga_el_cuerpo_de_la_figura: Loads the figure's body from an STL file.
window.guardar_una_copia_del_proyecto_con: Save a copy of the project with another name or in another folder.
window.encuadrar_la_figura_en_el_visor: Frame the figure in the viewer
window.la_figura_generada_quedo_desactualizada_: The generated figure is out of date: you changed the project since the last generation.
window.articulacion_de_la_pieza_de_catalogo: Catalog part's joint: the axis, plane and range are the part's.
window.se_aplica_al_exportar_no_obliga: It is applied when exporting: you do not have to generate again.
window.mods_modificado_s_respecto_de_los: %{mods} modified compared with the default values.
window.mira_del_plano_name_cinta_de: Sight of plane %{name} (color band and section)
window.la_cadera_tiene_mecanismo_de_clic: The hip has a click mechanism
window.rellenar_los_muslos_talla_la_pelvis: Filling the thighs carves the pelvis around the lengthened thigh and may cut the click tabs: the hip click might stop working. On export, how much is lost is reported. Fill anyway?
window.los_tres_ejes_juntos_escala_uniforme: The three axes together (uniform scale). Unchecked, each axis is independent.
window.superpone_la_cara_de_la_pieza: Overlays the part's face and the model's and explains the coupling
window.abri_un_catalogo_con_una_figura: Open a catalog with a complete template figure (head, torso, arm and leg from the same source).
window.ajustar_cintura_y_muneca_al_patron: Adjust waist and wrist to the template
window.al_aplicar_escalar_tambien_la_pelvis: When applying, also scale the template pelvis with the leftover scale
window.carpeta_nueva_para_el_catalogo_de: New folder for the line's catalog
window.guardar_como_version_nueva_si_la: Save as a new version if the part already exists
window.cambiar_hacia_donde_mira_la_figura: Change which way the figure faces
window.carpeta_donde_exportar_las_piezas: Folder to export the parts to
window.carpeta_donde_guardar_las_probetas: Folder to save the test coupons in
window.agrega_la_rodilla_o_el_codo: Add the knee or elbow of a limb, or a leg (hip), in the Planes tab.
window.muneca_del_modelo_v_mm_de: Model wrist Ø%{v} mm · hand Ø%{v2} mm (step %{escalon_mm} mm)
window.se_activa_mientras_colocas_el_pasador: It turns on while you place the neck or waist pin.
window.escala_toda_la_figura_para_que: Scales the WHOLE figure so this place's face has the size of the part's
window.escala_por_separado_ancho_profundidad_y: Scales separately the width, depth and height of the model part that carries this joint so its face has the width and height of the chosen part's; it does not touch the thickness or the other parts. Then check IoU, step and wall.
window.quita_la_rodilla_codo_del_modelo: Removes the model's knee/elbow on this limb
window.vuelve_a_la_pieza_del_modelo: Goes back to the model's part in this place
window.verde_lo_que_se_toca_rojo: Green: what touches · red: part's excess · amber: model's excess · blue: model contour · orange: part contour
window.cada_corte_se_mide_sobre_la: Each cut is measured on the open figure (without generating). “As plug” is the part that would come out of this figure placed on other catalog torsos; “as socket”, this figure's torso with parts from others.
window.image_si_un_plano_no_cae:
%{image}
If a plane does not land where it should, fix it in Planes or in the outline editor.
window.compara_el_tamano_de_la_cara: Compares the size of this figure's waist and wrist faces with those of the catalog template's pelvis and hand and proposes how much to move each plane. “Apply” only moves the planes; if there is leftover scale, the text says so.
window.nombre_de_la_linea_letras_numeros: Line name (letters, numbers, hyphens and dots)
window.altura_de_la_figura_de_la: Line figure height, feet to crown (mm)
window.y_no_se_puede_deshacer_cambiar: and it cannot be undone. Change anyway?
window.el_catalogo_abierto_no_tiene_accesorios: The open catalog has no accessories: import a weapon above.
window.clic_ir_al_proximo_paso_pendiente: (click: go to the next pending step)
window.mover_este_corte_a_la_misma: Move this cut to the same distance from the symmetry plane as the chosen catalog part's
window.colocar_el_pasador_sobre_la_cara: Place the pin on the cut face
window.colocar_el_eje_de_la_bisagra: Place the hinge axis (click on the side of the figure)
window.inclinacion_del_eje_vista_de_frente: Axis tilt, front view (°; positive = rises toward +X)
window.escalar_la_figura_a_la_altura: Scale the figure to the line height (×%{scale})
window.iguala_el_radio_de_las_caras: Matches the radius of the joining faces. Then check IoU, step and wall.
window.no_se_pudo_completar_la_accion: The action could not be completed
window.ajustar_las_guias_de_las_2: Adjust the 2-line guides from the side (4 clicks in the “Side” view); it recalculates the cut and the axis
window.abre_administrar_catalogo_con_esta_pieza: Opens “Manage catalog” with this part so you can move the hinge axis, tilt the plane or change the range while watching the gap; it is saved as a new version of the part (then choose it in this place).
window.idioma_de_la_interfaz: Interface language (remembered for the next start)
window.espera_a_que_termine_la_tarea_para_cambi: Wait for the current task to finish before changing the language.
window.dibuja_o_edita_la_silueta_del_miembro: Draws or edits the limb outline (the contour on the row’s plane, the side one)
window.quitar_la_silueta_de_name: Remove the outline of “%{name}” (the limb goes back to pending an outline; the 2nd outline is not touched)
window.dibuja_o_edita_la_2_a_silueta: Draws or edits the 2nd outline (on the perpendicular plane, normally from the front). The limb is what stays inside the two outlines
window.quitar_la_2_a_silueta_de_name: Remove the 2nd outline of “%{name}” (the main outline is not touched)
window.quitar_el_plano_entero_con_sus_siluetas: Remove the whole plane (with its outlines)
window.dibuja_o_edita_la_3_a_silueta: Draw or edit the 3rd outline: the top view. Use it when the limb overlaps another part in the side and front views
window.no_hay_una_mano_pegada_a_la_figura: No hand is attached to the figure
window.tomo_la_mano_del_catalogo_ref_para: Take the catalog's hand (%{ref}) to preview the grip? It is shown alone in the viewer; it is not attached to the figure and the catalog is not modified.
window.agarre_centro_al_final: center at the far end of the hand
window.agarre_aviso_titulo: Warning: the bore does not meet the recommended measurements
window.agarre_aviso_sigue: Continuing with your manual choice: what you see on screen takes precedence over the automatic measurement. Check the result before printing.
window.propagar_resumen: Chosen cell: %{detalle}. It is already in the open figure (generate again).
window.propagar_donde_mas: Where else do you want these values? Only they change: everything else in each destination stays as it was.

window.propagar_sin_catalogos: There is no open or remembered catalog.

color.ayuda_sin_color: do not generate colour even if --color-desde is given

param_help.clearance: Free space between the moving part and the cavity it sits in. Higher: it turns freely and prints without seizing, but has some play. Lower: a tighter fit, but it can stick if the printer is not accurate.
param_help.burr: How much the edge of the contact face between body and limb is shaved so print burrs do not stop them from fitting together. Higher: fits more easily, but leaves a small step.
param_help.sit_angle: Hip angle at which the figure is printed and previewed sitting. 0° = legs down, 90° = thighs horizontal. It also sets how far the torso is carved so the leg can bend.
param_help.flat_depth: Height above the lowest point of the tail at which the figure is cut to lie flat on the bed (support-free printing). Higher: a wider, steadier base, but more of the figure is lost.
param_help.torso_mirror: Makes the torso symmetric by copying one half onto the other. Off: the torso is kept as it comes in the STL, even if it is asymmetric.
param_help.hip_margin: Extra degrees, beyond the sitting pose, that the torso is carved so the leg can bend. Higher: the leg turns further before colliding, but more torso material is removed.
param_help.pin_shaft_d: Diameter of the shaft (the thin part) of the %{joint} pin. Higher: a stronger pin, but it needs more room and leaves less wall. Lower: weaker. If it does not fit in the part, it shrinks by itself.
param_help.pin_shaft_len: Shaft length of the %{joint} pin: the distance between the part and the head. It sets the wall left behind the head (length − 2·clearance). Higher: a thicker wall, but the joint sits further apart.
param_help.pin_head_d: Diameter of the head (the mushroom) of the %{joint} pin, which keeps it from coming out. It has to be much larger than the shaft to retain (ratio of 1.6 or more). Higher: holds better, but needs more room.
param_help.pin_head_h: Height of the head of the %{joint} pin. Higher: a sturdier head that does not break, but more material and more overhang when printing. Lower: prints better, but is more fragile.
param_help.waist_twist: Angle the chest must be able to turn to each side of the waist without colliding. The engine checks it every 5°. Higher: more turn is required; if something collides earlier, the report gives the maximum possible.
param_help.shoulder_detent: Adds a click mechanism to the shoulder: a notched disc on the arm and two tabs on the torso that lock it at certain angles. Off: only the mushroom pin, which turns freely.
param_help.hip_detent: Adds a click mechanism to the hip: a notched disc on the leg and two tabs on the torso that lock it at certain angles. Off: only the mushroom pin, which turns freely.
param_help.detent_n_notches: Number of notches on the disc, that is, how many click positions there are per turn (4 = one every 90°). More notches: more positions, but smaller and more delicate.
param_help.detent_disc_d: Diameter of the notched disc. Higher: deeper notches and a firmer click, but it needs more room in the shoulder or hip.
param_help.detent_disc_h: Thickness of the disc. Higher: a stronger disc and more support for the tab tip, but the assembly takes up more length.
param_help.detent_notch_depth: Depth of each notch. Higher: a more marked click, but the tab bends more and works harder. Lower: a soft click that is easy to overcome.
param_help.detent_flank_deg: Slope of the notch walls. Higher: steeper flanks, so the click is harder to overcome. Lower: gentle flanks, the joint turns with less effort and the click is weaker.
param_help.detent_tip_r: Rounding radius of the tab tip that drops into the notch. Higher: a blunt tip, softer click. Lower: a finer tip, a more marked click.
param_help.detent_detent_gap: Space between the tab tip and the bottom of the notch. Higher: it does not fuse when printing, but the click is loose. Lower: firmer, but the tip can end up welded to the notch.
param_help.detent_slit_w: Width of the slots that free the tab around and underneath it. Higher: the separation prints reliably, but there is more play. Lower: more compact, with a risk of fusing.
param_help.detent_flex_gap: Free space above the tab (flex + slot) so it can lift when leaving the notch. Higher: more travel to bend. Lower: saves room but holds the tab back.
param_help.detent_finger_t: Thickness of the tab. Higher: stiffer, a stronger and sturdier click. Lower: more flexible, but it can break or fail to hold the position.
param_help.detent_finger_len: Length of the tab. Higher: more flexible and less stress when bending, but it needs more room in the torso; if there is no room, the engine shortens it and says so. Lower: stiffer.
param_help.detent_finger_w: Width of the tab. Higher: stiffer and stronger. Lower: more flexible and easier to break.
param_help.detent_print_angle: Angle at which the arm is printed, which sets the angles where the clicks fall. On the shoulder, with 10° the clicks are at 10°, 100°, 190° and 280°.
param_help.hinge_pin_pin_d: Diameter of the pin (the cylindrical peg) of the knee or elbow. Higher: stronger, but leaves less wall in thin limbs. Lower: weaker and close to the minimum that prints well.
param_help.hinge_pin_pin_len: How far each pin sticks out from the tab side, into the limb. Higher: holds better, but leaves less wall. Lower: more wall, but the tab is held less.
param_help.hinge_pin_tongue_t: Thickness of the hinge tab (the part that goes into the slot). Higher: stronger, but the slot in the other limb is wider. Lower: more fragile.
param_help.hinge_pin_end_r: Radius of the round tip of the tab around the axis (with a straight neck, the width is 2 × radius). Higher: a sturdier tab and more wall around the pin, but it takes more room.
param_help.hinge_pin_neck: On: the tab is an inverted U with straight sides that go down to the body; it is stronger and prints without supports. Off: a round disc that only touches the body along a short chord.
param_help.hinge_pin_rod: On: a single shaft welded to the tab crosses a hole in the arm and holds it. Off: two short pins, one on each side of the tab.
param_help.hinge_pin_rod_wall: Material left covering each end of the shaft on the outside of the arm. Higher: more wall, but the shaft gets shorter. 0 = a hole open from side to side.
